source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 10 mathematics textbooks (advanced stream)

stages.headline: The imaginary unit i satisfies i² = −1; numbers a + bi (a, b ∈ ℝ) are complex numbers with real part a and imaginary part b.
stages.headlineEnglish: The imaginary unit i satisfies i² = −1; numbers a + bi (a, b ∈ ℝ) are complex numbers with real part a and imaginary part b.

stages.headline: Add and multiply like polynomials, replacing i² by −1: (2 + 3i) + (1 − i) = 3 + 2i, (2 + 3i)(1 − i) = 5 + i.
stages.headlineEnglish: Add and multiply like polynomials, replacing i² by −1: (2 + 3i) + (1 − i) = 3 + 2i, (2 + 3i)(1 − i) = 5 + i.

stages.headline: The conjugate of a + bi is a − bi and their product is a² + b²; to divide, multiply top and bottom by the conjugate of the denominator.
stages.headlineEnglish: The conjugate of a + bi is a − bi and their product is a² + b²; to divide, multiply top and bottom by the conjugate of the denominator.
